title: GdprImpactAssessment
description: GDPR-sourced archetype — data protection impact assessment (DPIA) under Regulation (EU) 2016/679. Article 35 requires a DPIA when processing is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons. Rootless — regulatory compliance dimension. Source: GDPR Articles 35, 36.

highRiskProcessing.description: Whether the processing is likely to result in a high risk to rights and freedoms, triggering the DPIA obligation. Required in particular for: (a) systematic and extensive profiling with significant effects (Art 35(3)(a)); (b) large-scale processing of special categories or criminal data (Art 35(3)(b)); (c) systematic monitoring of publicly accessible areas on a large scale (Art 35(3)(c)).

dpiaConducted.description: Whether a DPIA has been conducted. Source: GDPR Art 35(1).

systematicDescriptionProvided.description: Whether the DPIA contains a systematic description of the envisaged processing operations and purposes, including legitimate interest if applicable. Source: GDPR Art 35(7)(a).

necessityAssessmentPerformed.description: Whether an assessment of the necessity and proportionality of the processing in relation to the purposes has been performed. Source: GDPR Art 35(7)(b).

riskAssessmentPerformed.description: Whether an assessment of the risks to the rights and freedoms of data subjects has been performed. Source: GDPR Art 35(7)(c).

mitigationMeasuresIdentified.description: Whether measures to address the risks have been identified, including safeguards, security measures, and mechanisms to ensure protection and demonstrate compliance. Source: GDPR Art 35(7)(d).

dpiaContentsComplete.description: Whether the DPIA contains all elements required by Art 35(7)(a)-(d): systematic description, necessity/proportionality assessment, risk assessment, and mitigation measures.

residualHighRisk.description: Whether residual high risk remains after mitigation measures, triggering the Art 36 prior consultation obligation with the supervisory authority.

priorConsultationCompleted.description: Whether prior consultation with the supervisory authority has been completed. Required when residual high risk remains. Source: GDPR Art 36(1).
